motion.notes_motion: Quietest motion in the expressive set. scroll_effects diff = 3 pin only, 0 real transitions after dropping from==to: NO parallax/scroll-scale/scroll-rotate/recolor (frames confirm the 3D object scrolls as ordinary content, never idle-spins). ~6555 rAF/scroll with canvas:0 + libraries:[] = cursor-follower (2 nodes, 14 mousemove) + audio-bar loop, NOT WebGL, so the claymorphic object is a pre-rendered still. Entrance: 2 reveals only (opacity 0->1 hero block + logo-rise), staggeredEntrance:false. rootMargin:200px. reduced-motion NOT gated.

notes: Trusts screenshot over raw profile. bg from raw rgb(241,236,233)=#f1ece9 (warm bone), confirmed in both captures. fg/muted are NOT in the raw profile (it only captured bg) — sampled from the near-black serif ink in screenshots and inferred. SINGLE serif family for display AND body — no sans/mono on the page; the listed family is the raw value, fallbacks trimmed to essentials. Scale normalized to 3 used steps: 16px body, 20px sub-lead, ~60px display (raw 59.59px rounded to text-5xl 3.75rem). Note the inverted weight ramp — weight DROPS as size grows (400 body -> 300 sub -> 200 display) to keep large type elegant; captured as weights [200,300,400]. leading: raw line-heights 24px/16px=1.5 body, 27/20=1.35 sub, 52/60=0.88 display (very tight display leading is load-bearing for the bracketed-headline look). radius full (raw 3.35e7px = effectively pill/circle, used by the toggle + 'Team +' outline pill). No shadows, no real accent color — accent role aliased to ink because hierarchy uses scale, not color. Tracking (not in this schema): display ~-1.2px negative is essential at size. The 3D object colors are sampled estimates, not from raw.
